metaDescription: Free online Stair Calculator. Calculate stair rise and run.
intro: Use our free online Stair Calculator tool. It estimates stair stringer dimensions based on your inputs.
whatIs: The Stair Calculator is an online utility that estimates stair stringer dimensions. It processes your total rise and provides number of steps and exact riser height.
howToUse: Enter your total rise into the designated input field.
Provide any secondary parameters like tread depth.
Click the calculate or submit button to generate number of steps and exact riser height.
Copy or review the resulting output for your needs.
howItWorks: This tool operates in your browser by applying standard algorithms to your total rise. It instantly processes the data to output number of steps and exact riser height.
workedExample: For example: 35 inch total rise requires 5 steps of 7 inches.
resultInterpretation: The result represents number of steps and exact riser height. You can use this data for your specific calculations or formatting needs.
useCases: Quickly processing total rise on the go
tipsAndLimitations: Building codes strictly dictate maximum riser height.
Ensure your inputs are formatted correctly for the best results.
The tool runs completely client-side, ensuring your data remains private.
